purpose: Optional native MiniCPM-o 4.5 text-output inference provider (LLM, VPM, APM only)

patches.purpose: Expose the pinned omni library through the stable omni_text_runtime target and evaluate user text in the synchronous prefill path used by the Jarvis adapter

excluded: TTS model loading and speech output
acquisition: The SHA-256-verified pinned archive is extracted under third_party/runtime/vendor. It is retained as a source snapshot and is not built until the reviewed text-only provider target exists.
